Timberwolves 133Mavericks 94

Ball and Hyland make 11 threes in a 39-point win

Final · Thu, Nov 12 · Minnesota

Minnesota beat Dallas 133–94, a 39-point home win. The Timberwolves move to 9–3; the Mavericks fall to 7–5.

Won it from deep and on the glass.

Rebounds 50–38; assists 33–26. Dallas made 13 of 48 threes.
